title: A service working when run manually proves nothing about SCM startup (error 1920 / event 7009)
symptoms: Service starts fine via `app.exe --service` in a shell but fails under the SCM with error 1920 or event 7009 (30s timeout)
msiexec exit 1603 during install-time service start
'service failed to start... The operation completed successfully' — red herring, not a success
explanation: SCM context differs from interactive: (1) it uses the machine-wide System PATH, not your user PATH — bare-command Process.Start lookups can silently fail to resolve; (2) Session 0 has no console, so Console/ILogger console output is invisible.
diagnosis: Check [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PATH','Machine') rather than your shell's PATH. Add a temporary raw File.AppendAllText trace (bypassing ILogger/DI) at each startup checkpoint — it's the only logging that survives a no-console SCM launch.
